const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""KinDER i00 seesaw task controller and episode record helper.
+
+All actions are issued through the documented rcb_client API. This file is
+kept as the working record of the control strategy used for the episode.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def connect():
+    robot = Robot()
+    print(json.dumps(robot.spec(), indent=2))
+    print('STATUS', json.dumps(robot.status()))
+    obs = robot.get_obs(video='none', include_depth=True)
+    for name, frame in obs.last.items():
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'initial_{name}.png')
+    for name, depth in getattr(obs, 'depth', {}).items():
+        np.save(OUT / f'initial_{name}_depth.npy', depth)
+    print('OBS', json.dumps(obs.meta, default=str))
+    return robot
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    connect()
*** End Patch";
const res = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(res);

 import numpy as np
+from scipy.optimize import least_squares
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
 from rcb_client import Robot
@@
 OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+# Neutral joint origins, axes, and grasp point are from r.spec().
+JOINT_POS = np.array([
+    [.1199, 0.0, .5512], [.1199, -.0054, .6796], [.1199, -.0117, .89],
+    [.1199, -.0181, 1.1004], [.1199, -.0245, 1.3088],
+    [.1199, -.0247, 1.4147], [.1199, -.0249, 1.5207],
+])
+JOINT_AXIS = np.array([
+    [0., 0., -1.], [0., 1., 0.], [0., 0., -1.], [0., 1., 0.],
+    [0., 0., -1.], [0., 1., 0.], [0., 0., -1.],
+])
+EE_ZERO = np.array([.1199, -.0249, 1.7261])
+
+
+def fk(q):
+    """Forward kinematics in the base frame using the documented neutral pose."""
+    R = np.eye(3)
+    t = np.zeros(3)
+    for i, axis0 in enumerate(JOINT_AXIS):
+        pivot = R @ JOINT_POS[i] + t
+        axis = R @ axis0
+        turn = Rotation.from_rotvec(axis * float(q[i])).as_matrix()
+        R, t = turn @ R, pivot + turn @ (t - pivot)
+    return R @ EE_ZERO + t, R
+
+
+def solve_ik(position, seed, rotation=None):
+    """Numerical position/orientation IK, with a small preference for the seed pose."""
+    position = np.asarray(position, dtype=float)
+    seed = np.asarray(seed, dtype=float)
+    if rotation is None:
+        rotation = fk(seed)[1]
+    lower, upper = seed - np.pi, seed + np.pi
+    lower[[1, 3, 5]] = [-2.24, -2.57, -2.09]
+    upper[[1, 3, 5]] = [2.24, 2.57, 2.09]
+
+    def residual(q):
+        p, R = fk(q)
+        r = Rotation.from_matrix(rotation.T @ R).as_rotvec()
+        return np.r_[p - position, .25 * r, .008 * (q - seed)]
+
+    fit = least_squares(residual, np.clip(seed, lower + 1e-5, upper - 1e-5),
+                        bounds=(lower, upper), max_nfev=160, xtol=1e-9,
+                        ftol=1e-9, gtol=1e-9)
+    p, R = fk(fit.x)
+    angle = np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(rotation.T @ R).as_rotvec())
+    print('IK', {'position_error_m': float(np.linalg.norm(p - position)),
+                 'orientation_error_deg': float(np.degrees(angle)),
+                 'q': fit.x.tolist()})
+    return fit.x
+
+
+def world_to_base(position_world, proprio):
+    bx, by, yaw = proprio[0], proprio[1], proprio[2]
+    dx, dy = position_world[0] - bx, position_world[1] - by
+    c, s = np.cos(yaw), np.sin(yaw)
+    return np.array([c * dx + s * dy, -s * dx + c * dy, position_world[2]])
+

+def move_arm_to(robot, goal, tag, grip=None, max_steps=90, tolerance=.018):
+    """Closed-loop bounded-joint stepper. Each request consumes one real control row."""
+    layout = robot.spec()['proprio_layout']
+    arm_ids = [layout.index(f'arm_{i}') for i in range(1, 8)]
+    grip_id = layout.index('gripper')

+        now = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+        current = now[arm_ids]
+        err = np.asarray(goal) - current
+        if np.max(np.abs(err)) < tolerance:
+            print('ARM_SETTLED', tag, step, np.round(current, 4).tolist())
+            break
+        action = np.zeros((1, 11), dtype=np.float32)
+        action[0, 3:10] = np.clip(err, -.09, .09)
+        action[0, 10] = now[grip_id] if grip is None else float(grip)
+        last = robot.submit('delta', action, cameras=['robot_wrist'], video='none',
+                            note=f'{tag}_{step:02d}')

lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)
